extracted.name: Heart Shaped Churros
instruction_lines: Bring a pot with water to a boil, add the salt and butter.
Once it boils, add the flour.
Remove from heat and mix (you can add a teaspoon of vanilla here too)
Heat a pan and add oil. Meanwhile put the mix into the piping bag.
With the piping tip and bag, pipe heart shaped churros.
Add the fried churros to a bowl of sugar and cinnamon.
Once it’s boiling fry the churros. Use parchment paper so it’s easier to fry them.
